notes: SYSTEM-BROWSER-SPEC §2.4. User Smalltalk executes inside the daemon, so the primitive set is the security model: everything a class can do to the world is a send to one of the declared capability classes (5.130.0). Pharo has no such boundary — everything can do anything — so there is nothing there to compute a reach against. A 🔐 Reach tab, st_capability_reach, and a transitive walk of the send graph.
